newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares end up, await budget news.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares end up, await budget news.

text.p: Greek equities ended up 0.15 percent after oscillating around 962 points for most of the session and fund managers said the market will be channel bound in the short run and depend on upcoming budget announcements.

"The market will be range trading in the short-run awaiting concrete economic measures from the new government," the manager of a private investment firm told Reuters. "Sentiment has improved but the bourse is dependent on the 1997 budget announcements."
Prime Minister Costas Simitis will make a speech on his government's economic policy on October 10 in parliament.
"The outlook favours a gradual climb of the benchmark index in the future," he said.
The Athens general share index closed 0.15 percent, or 1.42 points higher at 962.77 from Thursday's 961.35 close after opening at 961.34 points.
Turnover stood at 6.72 billion drachmas on volume of 3.21 million shares. There was block trade in the Bank of Piraeus.
Gainers traced decliners 72 to 129 with 35 issues unchanged on 236 traded. Banks gained 0.25 percent, industrials firmed 0.09 percent and construction fell 0.20 percent. Small-caps fell 0.52 percent.

Greece's new socialist cabinet was sworn in last week with Yannos Papandoniou elevated to economic "czar", heading both the national economy and finance ministries. The socialists have a comfortable 162-seat majority in the 300-seat parliament.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 561-579 at the close. Shares of OTE telecom OTEr.AT, the underlying, ended up 20 drachmas at 4,100.

The recently launched Merrill Lynch stock index call warrant based on a basket of 23 shares was higher at 202.00-212.60 drachmas. It expires on January 9 1998 with a strike price of 1000. It was in the money at 1050.4.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted higher at 4,328-4,609 drachmas at the close.
